Senses.Explanation: Named respondents in several records answer a follow-up by demanding their own preceding words back. Shoushan Xingnian says it after the questioner asks for the import of seeing buddhas in every mote; Yunmen Wenyan uses it after the questioner asks why Yunmen is in his belly; Nanyue Falun Qitian says it after asking whether the questioner heard the drum; Luohan Yuanzhao and Tianyi Yihuai use it when a questioner asks how to continue or understand a preceding reply. The first-person pronoun meaning 'my' makes the object the respondent's preceding words or remark here, not an independent technical object.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: The possessive demand always asks an interlocutor to return the respondent's immediately preceding words or remark; no retained use names a detached technical object or exercise.
